options.learner_label: Never state a price, stock level or policy the shop records do not support
Re-verify every exact price and stock claim against the newest record before answering
Answer from the newest record you have and report how old it is; refuse stock, price or availability claims from records older than one hour (ask, decline or escalate instead)
Hard-verify only high-risk claims (price): refuse a price from a record older than one hour; answer stock and availability from the newest cached record
Ask which title or edition the customer means when a request is ambiguous
Ask whenever any fact in the request is uncertain
Ask only when an uncertain fact is high-risk
Hand off to a human instead of continuing an unsafe request
Escalate when a repair would be unsafe to apply automatically
Give an estimate only when evidence supports it, clearly labelled
